ITEM 1 | Roasted potato wedges, pale golden-yellow flesh with light browned, slightly crisp edges and a few darker caramelized spots; roughly 5 pieces, each about 2.5-3 cm across and 1.5-2 cm thick, irregular cut faces, matte with slight oil sheen; sits on the left side of the plate | 75
ITEM 2 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, glossy and slightly wilted with soft, moist texture; leaves folded and overlapping, covering roughly 30% of the plate in the upper-right area; thin stems visible; low height, about 1 cm at thickest | 60
ITEM 3 | Shredded carrot, bright orange julienne strands about 5-8 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, slightly moist, scattered among and over the spinach leaves on the right-center of the plate | 15
